sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS todos (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, owner_id TEXT, title TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(trim(title)) BETWEEN 1 AND 200), description TEXT, status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending' CHECK(status IN ('pending','completed')), due_at TEXT, due_precision TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unknown' CHECK(due_precision IN ('date','datetime','unknown')), created_at TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL, completed_at TEXT, source_type TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'manual' CHECK(source_type IN ('manual','screenshot','share')), source_id TEXT UNIQUE, sort_order REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, visibility TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'private' CHECK(visibility IN ('private','shared')), sync_state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'local' CHECK(sync_state IN ('local','pending','synced'))); CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS analyses (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, image_fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, captured_at TEXT NOT NULL, received_at TEXT NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('queued','processing','review','saved','ignored','failed','empty')), source_channel TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(source_channel IN ('shortcuts','share','manual')), model_version TEXT, error_code TEXT, expires_at TEXT NOT NULL); CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS extracted_tasks (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, analysis_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES analyses(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, title TEXT NOT NULL, description TEXT, due_at TEXT, due_precision TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(due_precision IN ('date','datetime','unknown')), assignee TEXT, confidence REAL NOT NULL CHECK(confidence BETWEEN 0 AND 1), evidence_text TEXT NOT NULL, needs_confirmation INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, review_status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending' CHECK(review_status IN ('pending','saved','ignored')), linked_todo_id TEXT REFERENCES todos(id) ON DELETE SET NULL); CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS preferences (key TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, value TEXT NOT NULL); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS todos_status_due ON todos(status,due_at); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS tasks_analysis ON extracted_tasks(analysis_id); PRAGMA user_version = 1;
